plan_review.notes: Initial suppression-only plan rejected: post-quest Hunt unavailable, Engage radius-limited, ignored threats could deadlock, scan-wide latch too broad, permanent A/B arm costly. Revised to explicit pre-Progress node owning only retreat-triggering eid; proof arm removed after A/B. Immediate endRetreat ignore is skipped only for owned threat, later watchdog ignore clears recovery. Final includes class arbitration plus exact headless regressions and in-range Interact ordering coverage.

findings.detail: The recovery watchdog clock only samples target HP when LocalThreatRecovery ticks, while frameCount continues under higher-priority Retreat. Re-latching the same eid does not reset the timer, so a long retreat can make the next recovery tick conservatively blacklist the threat. This yields to progression and cannot deadlock; refreshing the timer or health sample on same-eid re-latch would align semantics more precisely.

The non-obvious recovery ownership, HP-progress watchdog, and endRetreat blacklist exemption are documented in the handoff rather than beside the implementation. A short rationale comment would reduce future archaeology.

The abandonment test writes private watchdog fields to isolate the timeout branch rather than advancing frames, and does not directly cover every map/range cleanup branch. Additional black-box timing and cleanup tests would harden the suite.

independent_grade.notes: Independent verification at HEAD 7e0a217c found the exact fix fail-to-pass, the targeted and broader suites green, deterministic frame-based behavior, correct layer boundaries, bounded recovery, and complete process artifacts. Residual findings are minor and non-blocking.
